simpleJp: 最初のスフィンクス問題で「人間」を選ぶ
jpGuide1: 問題の答えは「人間」「用心棒ジェフリー」「ゴッズ」「地」「鳥」「イービルアイ」
enGuide: Story progression. Continue directly from “【任意】紋次編前：バルバラード→各地最終回収”. Use those answers in order as you move through the Sphinx rooms. Answering correctly opens the route deeper into the Pyramid.

At Sphinx question 2, choose the exact answer 「用心棒ジェフリー」. This is the second answer in the fixed six-question sequence; continue forward to the next Sphinx rather than leaving the Pyramid between questions.
At Sphinx question 3, choose the exact answer 「ゴッズ」. Continue through the same Pyramid quiz sequence immediately afterward; this is progression, not an optional dialogue branch.
At Sphinx question 4, choose the exact answer 「地」. Keep following the Sphinx-room sequence after the answer; the route is building toward the upper-floor quicksand puzzle.
At Sphinx question 5, choose the exact answer 「鳥」. Continue directly to the final Sphinx question after this choice; do not detour out of the Pyramid.
At Sphinx question 6, choose the exact answer 「イービルアイ」. This completes the six-answer quiz sequence and opens the route into the remaining Pyramid traversal and boss section.

simpleJp: 1F中央の穴からB1の宝を回収する
jpGuide1: B1にある宝は、1F中央の穴に落ちると取れる。
enGuide: For the optional B1 treasure, approach the central hole from below and step onto the front-right fall tile. Loot the basement area before returning to the main route.

simpleJp: 3Fのスイッチで流砂を変えて最上階へ行く
jpGuide1: 3FではスイッチをONにすると流砂の流れを変えて最上階へ行く。
jpGuide2: 3Fの右側の石を押してスイッチをON→流砂の流れを変える
enGuide: Push the stone on the right side of 3F onto/into the switch position. Turning the switch ON changes the quicksand flow so you can reach the upper floors.

simpleJp: 最上階でカサドールを倒す
jpGuide1: 倒すとバルバラードはクリア。ピラミッドには入れなくなる。
enGuide: The Pyramid becomes inaccessible after the boss. Use Gogen's Teleport for lower treasure if desired, verify the unique loot, then defeat Casador to end the Barbarad arc. Next: “パレンシアタワー〜過去編”.
